stories.title: Stories
stories.description: Beautiful stories with morals — festivals, family, and more!

diwali.title: The Story of Diwali
diwali.subtitle: The Festival of Lights
diwali.moral: Good always triumphs over evil, and truth and kindness bring light into our lives.
diwali.p1: Long ago, there was a kind and brave prince named Rama, who lived in the beautiful kingdom of Ayodhya. He always followed the path of truth, respected everyone, and helped people in need. One day, Rama, his wife Sita, and his loyal brother Lakshmana went to live in the forest for fourteen years to honor his father's promise.
diwali.p2: While they were living in the forest, the demon king Ravana kidnapped Sita and took her to the island kingdom of Lanka. Rama set out to rescue her with the help of Hanuman, the brave Vanara army, and many loyal friends. After a great battle, Rama defeated Ravana, rescued Sita, and restored peace.
diwali.p3: When the fourteen years ended, Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana returned to Ayodhya. The people of Ayodhya were overjoyed to welcome them home. They cleaned their houses, decorated the streets, and lit thousands of diyas (oil lamps) to celebrate their return. The bright lights filled the entire city with happiness and hope.
diwali.p4: Since then, people celebrate Diwali, the Festival of Lights. Families decorate their homes with diyas and rangoli, wear new clothes, share sweets, pray together, and spend time with their loved ones. Diwali reminds us that goodness, truth, and kindness always triumph over evil.

holi.title: The Story of Holi
holi.subtitle: The Festival of Colors
holi.moral: Truth, faith, and kindness are always stronger than evil.
holi.p1: Long ago, there lived a kind and devoted boy named Prahlad. He was a great devotee of Lord Vishnu and always chose the path of truth, kindness, and goodness. However, his father, King Hiranyakashipu, wanted everyone to worship only him and became angry because Prahlad continued to worship Lord Vishnu.
holi.p2: The king tried many ways to stop Prahlad, but Prahlad's faith never changed. Finally, Hiranyakashipu asked his sister Holika to sit in a fire with Prahlad. Holika had received a special boon that protected her from fire. She believed this boon would keep her safe while Prahlad would be harmed.
holi.p3: According to the traditional story, because Holika misused her boon for a wrong purpose, the boon did not protect her. Holika was burned in the fire, but Prahlad remained safe through the blessings of Lord Vishnu and his unwavering faith.
holi.p4: People remember this victory of good over evil by celebrating Holika Dahan on the evening before Holi. The next day, families and friends celebrate Holi, the Festival of Colors. They play with bright colors, sing, dance, share sweets, and wish happiness to everyone.
holi.p5: Holi teaches us to let go of anger, forgive others, spread kindness, and celebrate love, friendship, and togetherness.

ganesh_chaturthi.title: The Story of Ganesh Chaturthi
ganesh_chaturthi.subtitle: The God of Wisdom and New Beginnings
ganesh_chaturthi.moral: Obey your parents, respect others, and always choose wisdom and kindness.
ganesh_chaturthi.p1: Long ago, Goddess Parvati wished to have someone who would always protect her. According to the traditional story, she made a young boy from sandalwood paste and gave him life. She named him Ganesha and asked him to guard the entrance while she was inside.
ganesh_chaturthi.p2: After some time, Lord Shiva returned home and wanted to enter. Ganesha did not know who Lord Shiva was and politely stopped him because he was following his mother's instructions. A misunderstanding took place, and in anger, Lord Shiva cut off Ganesha's head.
ganesh_chaturthi.p3: When Goddess Parvati learned what had happened, she became very sad. To make things right, Lord Shiva promised to bring Ganesha back to life. He asked his followers to bring the head of the first living being they found facing north, which was an elephant. Lord Shiva placed the elephant's head on Ganesha's body and brought him back to life.
ganesh_chaturthi.p4: Lord Shiva blessed Ganesha and declared that he would be worshipped before the beginning of every important work. Since then, Lord Ganesha has been known as the God of Wisdom, Knowledge, and New Beginnings.
ganesh_chaturthi.p5: Every year, people celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi with great joy. Families welcome Lord Ganesha's idol into their homes, decorate with flowers, sing prayers, offer sweets like modak, and pray for wisdom, happiness, and success. After the celebration, the idol is respectfully immersed in water, reminding everyone that life is a beautiful cycle of new beginnings.

christmas.title: The Story of Christmas
christmas.subtitle: A Celebration of Love and Peace
christmas.moral: Love everyone, help others, and always share kindness and happiness.
christmas.p1: Long ago, in the town of Bethlehem, a baby named Jesus was born to Mary and Joseph. According to the Christian tradition, Jesus was born in a simple stable because there was no room available at the inn. Baby Jesus was gently placed in a manger filled with soft hay.
christmas.p2: On the night Jesus was born, a bright star shone in the sky. Angels shared the joyful news with nearby shepherds, who happily came to visit the baby. Later, three wise men followed the bright star to Bethlehem. They brought special gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh to honor Jesus.
christmas.p3: As Jesus grew up, he taught people to love one another, help those in need, forgive others, and live with kindness, peace, and compassion. His teachings continue to inspire millions of people around the world.
christmas.p4: Today, people celebrate Christmas on 25th December. Families decorate Christmas trees, sing joyful carols, exchange gifts, share delicious meals, and spend happy time together. Many people also help those in need, remembering the message of love and generosity that Christmas represents.
christmas.p5: Christmas reminds us to fill our hearts with love, kindness, peace, and the joy of giving.

eid_ul_fitr.title: The Story of Eid-ul-Fitr
eid_ul_fitr.subtitle: A Festival of Gratitude and Togetherness
eid_ul_fitr.moral: Be thankful, help those in need, and spread kindness and joy with everyone.
eid_ul_fitr.p1: Eid-ul-Fitr is a joyful festival celebrated by Muslims around the world. It marks the end of the holy month of Ramadan, a special month during which many Muslims fast from dawn until sunset. During Ramadan, people spend more time praying, reading the Holy Quran, helping those in need, and practicing kindness, patience, and gratitude.
eid_ul_fitr.p2: When the new moon is seen, Ramadan ends and Eid-ul-Fitr begins. On the morning of Eid, families wear clean or new clothes and gather for a special prayer called the Eid prayer. Before the prayer, Muslims give Zakat al-Fitr, a special charity that helps people in need so everyone can celebrate the festival with happiness.
eid_ul_fitr.p3: After the prayer, families and friends greet each other by saying "Eid Mubarak," which means "Blessed Eid." They visit relatives and friends, enjoy delicious meals, share sweets, exchange gifts, and spend joyful time together. Children are often given small gifts or money called Eidi, making the festival even more exciting for them.
eid_ul_fitr.p4: Eid-ul-Fitr is a celebration of gratitude, generosity, forgiveness, and togetherness. It reminds everyone to care for others, share with those in need, and spread love and happiness in the community.

raksha_bandhan.title: The Story of Raksha Bandhan
raksha_bandhan.subtitle: The Bond of Love and Protection
raksha_bandhan.moral: Love, respect, and caring make family bonds strong and beautiful.
raksha_bandhan.p1: Raksha Bandhan is a beautiful Indian festival that celebrates the special bond of love, care, and protection between brothers and sisters. The name Raksha Bandhan means "the bond of protection."
raksha_bandhan.p2: On this special day, sisters tie a colorful thread called a Rakhi around their brothers' wrists. The Rakhi is a symbol of love, trust, and good wishes. Brothers promise to care for, respect, and support their sisters, and sisters pray for their brothers' happiness, good health, and success.
raksha_bandhan.p3: Families celebrate the festival by wearing traditional clothes, performing a small prayer, applying tilak, tying the Rakhi, exchanging sweets, and giving thoughtful gifts. Today, Raksha Bandhan is also celebrated between cousins, friends, and even people who wish to express love, respect, and care for one another.
raksha_bandhan.p4: Raksha Bandhan teaches us that true strength comes from love, respect, trust, and caring for our family and loved ones. It reminds us to protect not only our brothers and sisters but also to be kind, responsible, and supportive toward everyone.

lion_and_mouse.title: The Lion and the Mouse
lion_and_mouse.subtitle: A tiny friend can save the day
lion_and_mouse.moral: Never judge anyone by their size. Even the smallest friend can make a big difference.
lion_and_mouse.p1: One sunny afternoon, a mighty lion was sleeping peacefully under a large tree in the forest. A tiny little mouse was playing nearby with its friends. While running around, the mouse accidentally climbed onto the lion's back. The lion suddenly woke up and caught the little mouse with his big paw.
lion_and_mouse.p2: "Please let me go. I am very sorry. One day, I may be able to help you," said the frightened mouse. The lion laughed because he could not imagine how such a small mouse could ever help a strong lion. Still, the lion was kind and decided to let the little mouse go free.
lion_and_mouse.p3: A few days later, the lion was walking through the forest when he became trapped in a hunter's strong net. He roared loudly for help, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not escape.
lion_and_mouse.p4: The little mouse heard the lion's roar and quickly ran to help. Without wasting any time, the mouse began to nibble the ropes of the net with its sharp little teeth. Slowly, the ropes became weaker until they finally broke. The lion was free again.
lion_and_mouse.p5: The lion smiled and thanked the little mouse. He realized that even someone small can do great things. From that day on, the lion and the mouse became good friends and always helped each other whenever they could.

hare_and_tortoise.title: The Hare and the Tortoise
hare_and_tortoise.subtitle: Slow and steady wins the race
hare_and_tortoise.moral: Slow and steady wins the race. Patience, hard work, and determination lead to success.
hare_and_tortoise.p1: One day, a fast hare loved to boast about how quickly he could run. He often laughed at a slow-moving tortoise and said, "No one can beat me in a race!"
hare_and_tortoise.p2: The tortoise smiled and calmly replied, "Let's have a race and find out." The forest animals gathered to watch the exciting race. When the race began, the hare ran very fast and soon disappeared far ahead of the tortoise.
hare_and_tortoise.p3: After running a long distance, the hare looked back and saw that the tortoise was still far behind. Feeling very confident, the hare thought, "I have plenty of time. I'll take a short nap." He lay down under a shady tree and quickly fell asleep.
hare_and_tortoise.p4: Meanwhile, the tortoise kept walking slowly without stopping. Step by step, he moved closer to the finish line. He never gave up, even though he was much slower than the hare.
hare_and_tortoise.p5: After some time, the hare woke up and rushed toward the finish line as fast as he could. But it was too late. The tortoise had already crossed the finish line and won the race. All the animals cheered happily for the tortoise. The hare learned that being talented is not enough if we become careless. Success comes to those who stay focused, work hard, and never give up.

ant_and_grasshopper.title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
ant_and_grasshopper.subtitle: Prepare today for a better tomorrow
ant_and_grasshopper.moral: Hard work, preparation, and planning today help us face tomorrow with confidence.
ant_and_grasshopper.p1: On a warm summer day, a group of hardworking ants was busy collecting tiny grains of food. They carried the food back to their home one by one. Even though the work was difficult, the ants knew they had to prepare for the cold winter, when food would be hard to find.
ant_and_grasshopper.p2: Nearby, a cheerful grasshopper was singing, dancing, and enjoying the sunny weather. He watched the ants working and laughed. "Why are you working so hard?" he asked. "Come and play with me instead!"
ant_and_grasshopper.p3: One of the ants smiled and replied, "We are collecting food for the winter. It is important to be prepared for the future." But the grasshopper did not listen. He continued to play every day without thinking about what would happen when the seasons changed.
ant_and_grasshopper.p4: Soon, winter arrived. The weather became cold, and the ground was covered with snow. There were no green plants or fresh food to eat. The grasshopper became hungry and realized that he had nothing stored for the winter.
ant_and_grasshopper.p5: The ants had plenty of food because they had worked hard during the summer. Seeing the grasshopper in need, they reminded him that planning ahead is important. The grasshopper understood his mistake and promised that from then on, he would work hard and prepare for the future. From that day, he learned the value of hard work, responsibility, and good planning.

please_and_thank_you.title: The Power of Saying "Please" and "Thank You"
please_and_thank_you.subtitle: Magic words that spread kindness
please_and_thank_you.moral: Always say "Please" and "Thank You." Good manners show kindness and respect, and make everyone feel happy.
please_and_thank_you.p1: There was a little girl named Emma who was cheerful and loved playing with her friends. She was smart and kind, but sometimes she forgot to use the magic words "Please" and "Thank You." Whenever she wanted something, she would simply say, "Give me the toy," or "I want some juice." Although she did not mean to be rude, her words sometimes made others feel unhappy.
please_and_thank_you.p2: One day, Emma's teacher told the class that "Please" and "Thank You" are magical words. They do not create real magic, but they make people feel happy, respected, and appreciated. The teacher explained that good manners help us make friends and show kindness to others.
please_and_thank_you.p3: After school, Emma decided to try using the magic words. She smiled and said, "Mom, may I please have some water?" Her mother smiled warmly and gave her a glass of water. Emma happily replied, "Thank you, Mom!" Her mother gave her a big hug and said, "You are very welcome."
please_and_thank_you.p4: The next day, Emma asked her friend, "May I please play with your ball?" Her friend smiled and said, "Of course!" After playing together, Emma returned the ball and said, "Thank you for sharing." Her friend felt happy because Emma was polite and respectful.
please_and_thank_you.p5: Soon, Emma noticed that people smiled more when she used kind words. Her teachers, friends, and family were always happy to help her because she spoke with respect and gratitude. From that day on, Emma remembered to say "Please" whenever she asked for something and "Thank You" whenever someone helped her. She learned that these simple words can make every day brighter and every friendship stronger.

clever_merchants.title: The Clever Merchants
clever_merchants.subtitle: Courage and wit win the day
clever_merchants.moral: Even in a difficult situation, do not panic. Face problems bravely and make wise, clever decisions.
clever_merchants.p1: In a village lived some merchants who often travelled to different places to sell their goods. One day, while they were going to sell their goods, it became very late. They had to pass through a dark forest at night. Some robbers stopped them and stole all their goods.
clever_merchants.p2: The merchants were brave and clever. They thought of a smart plan. They told the robbers that they were excellent performers and would entertain them with a wonderful play. The robbers agreed and sat down to watch.
clever_merchants.p3: The merchants began their play. First, they dressed as shepherds and sang, "Here come the merchant performers, wearing a shepherd's costume." They acted as shepherds, then as carpenters, cobblers, and blacksmiths, and kept the robbers amused.
clever_merchants.p4: The robbers became so happy that they began to dance and sing with the merchants. Then the merchants started a play about thieves and police. Some merchants acted as thieves, and some acted as police. They showed how the police come and catch the robbers. The performers sang, "Here come the merchant performers, wearing a thief's costume. Run quickly, brother, run quickly — go and tell the police!"
clever_merchants.p5: Some merchants quietly went to the town and informed the real police about the robbers. The real police came back with them to the place where the play was going on. The merchants then sang, "Here come the merchant performers, wearing a police costume." The merchants dressed as police arrived, and the robbers thought this was still part of the play, so they kept dancing. Just then, the real police arrived and caught the robbers. The robbers still believed it was only a play! The police took the robbers to jail, and the merchants got their goods back. This story teaches us that even in a bad situation, we should not be afraid. We should face problems with courage and make clever, correct decisions.

magical_balloon.title: The Magical Balloon Adventure
magical_balloon.subtitle: A rainbow ride above the clouds
magical_balloon.moral: Imagination can turn an ordinary day into an amazing adventure.
magical_balloon.p1: One sunny morning, a curious little girl named Mia was playing in the park when she noticed a beautiful rainbow-colored balloon floating near a tree. It was unlike any balloon she had ever seen. Tiny sparkles danced around it, and it gently swayed in the breeze as if it were waiting for someone.
magical_balloon.p2: As soon as Mia held the balloon's string, something amazing happened. The balloon began to glow, and slowly it lifted her into the air. Mia wasn't scared at all. She felt as if she were floating on a soft cloud. Higher and higher they went, flying above green fields, winding rivers, and colorful gardens.
magical_balloon.p3: Their first stop was Candy Cloud Island, a magical place high in the sky. The clouds looked like cotton candy, chocolate rivers flowed through the land, and giant lollipops grew like trees. Mia played with friendly candy creatures, jumped on marshmallow hills, and enjoyed a delicious rainbow cupcake.
magical_balloon.p4: Next, the balloon carried her to the Rainbow Waterfall. Instead of water, colorful streams of light flowed down sparkling cliffs. Mia slid down a rainbow, bounced on fluffy clouds, and chased glowing butterflies that painted colors in the sky wherever they flew.
magical_balloon.p5: Then they visited the Starry Sky Playground, where children from magical lands played among twinkling stars. Mia rode a flying swing, hopped across moon-shaped stepping stones, and laughed as tiny star birds sang cheerful songs. As the sun began to set, the magical balloon gently carried Mia back to the park. Before floating away, it twinkled brightly and drew a shining heart in the sky. Mia waved goodbye with a smile, knowing she would never forget her wonderful adventure among the clouds, rainbows, and stars.

lost_baby_dinosaur.title: The Lost Baby Dinosaur
lost_baby_dinosaur.subtitle: A journey home filled with new friends
lost_baby_dinosaur.moral: Every adventure becomes more exciting when you meet new friends along the way.
lost_baby_dinosaur.p1: Deep inside a bright and colorful valley, a little baby dinosaur named Dino loved to explore. He was cheerful, playful, and always curious about everything around him. One morning, while chasing a group of colorful butterflies, Dino wandered farther and farther from home.
lost_baby_dinosaur.p2: After a while, Dino stopped and looked around. The butterflies had disappeared, and he could not see his family anywhere. The valley suddenly looked very different. Dino realized that he was lost. Feeling worried, he began searching for his way home. Along the way, he met a friendly parrot sitting on a tree branch. "Have you seen my family?" Dino asked. The parrot thought for a moment and pointed toward a sparkling river. "I saw some dinosaurs near the river this morning," he said.
lost_baby_dinosaur.p3: Dino thanked the parrot and hurried toward the river. When he arrived, he found a group of turtles swimming happily, but his family was not there. One of the turtles suggested that he check the Flower Hills nearby. At the Flower Hills, Dino met a cheerful rabbit who was hopping through giant flowers. The rabbit had not seen Dino's family either, but he offered to help. Together they followed a trail of large dinosaur footprints leading through the valley.
lost_baby_dinosaur.p4: The footprints led them to a beautiful meadow filled with bright flowers and tall trees. Suddenly, Dino heard a familiar voice calling his name. "Dino!" It was his family! They had been searching everywhere for him. Dino ran as fast as he could and gave his family a big hug. Everyone was happy to be together again.
lost_baby_dinosaur.p5: That evening, the dinosaurs celebrated with a picnic under the stars. Dino told everyone about the parrot, the turtles, and the rabbit who had helped him on his journey. As he looked up at the twinkling sky, he smiled, knowing he had made many new friends during his adventure.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Kids Learning World is an offline educational app for kids that helps them learn the alphabet, numbers, spelling, shapes, colors and everyday words in a fun and safe way.
privacy.s1Body: Kids Learning World does not collect, store or share any personal information from children or adults. We do not ask you to create an account, log in, enter your name, email, phone number or any other identifying data.
privacy.s2Body: The app is designed to work completely offline. Learning content is stored locally on your device, so no network connection is required for normal use.
privacy.s3Body:
Kids Learning World may use system text-to-speech (TTS) on your device to read words aloud. This feature is handled by the operating system and we do not record or transmit any audio.

We do not access your contacts, photos, location, microphone recordings, or any other sensitive data.
privacy.s4Body: The app does not contain third-party advertising, analytics SDKs, or tracking technologies. We do not use cookies or similar technologies to profile users.
privacy.s5Body: Kids Learning World is built for young learners. We have intentionally minimized data use and avoided any features that require children to share personal information. Parents and guardians are encouraged to supervise device use and help children understand safe use of apps.
privacy.s6Body: If we ever change how the app handles data, we will update this Privacy Policy inside the app and in the store listing. Any material changes will be clearly communicated so you can review them before continuing to use the app.
privacy.s7Body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact the developer using the email address provided in the store listing.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the Kids Learning World mobile application. By installing or using the app, you agree to these terms.
terms.s1Body: Kids Learning World is provided for personal, non-commercial educational use. You may not use the app for any unlawful or harmful purpose.
terms.s2Body: All graphics, text, sounds and other content in Kids Learning World are owned by the developer or licensed for use in the app. You may not copy, redistribute, sell, or otherwise exploit the content except as allowed by normal use of the app.
terms.s3Body: The app is provided “as is” without any warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee that the app will be error-free or available on all devices.
terms.s4Body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer is not liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use or inability to use the app, including loss of data or device issues.
terms.s5Title: 5. Changes to the app and terms
terms.s5Body: Features in Kids Learning World may change or be updated over time. We may update these Terms & Conditions as needed. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s6Body: Kids Learning World is designed for children, but it should be used under the guidance of a parent, guardian or teacher. Adults are responsible for supervising children’s use of the app and the device.
terms.s7Body: If you have any questions about these Terms & Conditions, you can contact the developer using the email address provided in the store listing.

communityHelpers.title: Community Helpers
communityHelpers.description: Tap a helper to hear the name and learn how they help.

teacher.about: A teacher helps children learn letters, numbers, stories, and good manners. Teachers explain new ideas patiently and cheer when kids try hard.
teacher.funFact: Did you know? Teachers prepare lessons before class so every child can learn something new each day.
teacher.try: Clap once and say "{name}!" Then pretend to write your name on a blackboard.

doctor.about: A doctor checks if we are healthy and helps us get better when we feel sick. Doctors listen carefully and tell families how to stay well.
doctor.funFact: Did you know? Doctors use a stethoscope to hear your heartbeat. It helps them understand how your body is working.
doctor.try: Say "{name}!" and pretend to check a teddy bear’s heartbeat gently.

nurse.about: A nurse cares for people in hospitals and clinics. Nurses give medicine carefully, check temperatures, and comfort patients with kind words.
nurse.funFact: Did you know? Nurses work closely with doctors so patients feel safe and get the right help at the right time.
nurse.try: Say "{name}!" Then gently wrap a soft cloth around a toy like a caring bandage.

policeOfficer.about: A police officer helps keep people, roads, and neighborhoods safe. Officers guide traffic, help lost people, and protect the community.
policeOfficer.funFact: Did you know? Police officers teach children road safety rules like looking both ways before crossing.
policeOfficer.try: Stand tall, salute politely, and say "{name}!" Practice looking left and right.

firefighter.about: A firefighter rushes to put out fires and rescue people in danger. Firefighters wear special jackets and helmets to stay safe while helping others.
firefighter.funFact: Did you know? Firefighters practice often so they can move quickly and work as a brave team.
firefighter.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to hold a hose and spray water on an imaginary fire.

farmer.about: A farmer grows fruits, vegetables, and grains that feed families. Farmers water plants, care for animals, and work hard in fields.
farmer.funFact: Did you know? Many foods in your kitchen start on a farm — rice, milk, wheat, and fresh vegetables.
farmer.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to dig soil and plant a seed with your fingers.

shopkeeper.about: A shopkeeper sells food, clothes, toys, and other useful things. Shopkeepers help families find what they need and pack items carefully.
shopkeeper.funFact: Did you know? A friendly shopkeeper greets customers and keeps shelves neat so shopping is easy.
shopkeeper.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to sell fruit to a friend and say "Thank you!"

busDriver.about: A bus driver takes many people safely from one place to another. Drivers stop at bus stops, watch the road carefully, and help passengers travel.
busDriver.funFact: Did you know? School bus drivers help children reach school and return home safely every day.
busDriver.try: Hold an imaginary steering wheel, say "{name}!" and pretend to stop at a bus stop.

postman.about: A postman delivers letters, cards, and parcels to homes. Postmen walk or ride through streets so messages and gifts reach the right doors.
postman.funFact: Did you know? People write addresses clearly so the postman can find every house correctly.
postman.try: Say "{name}!" Fold a paper letter and pretend to deliver it to someone at home.

cook.about: A cook prepares tasty and healthy meals. Cooks wash vegetables, mix ingredients carefully, and serve food with love.
cook.funFact: Did you know? Cooks wash hands before cooking so the food stays clean and safe to eat.
cook.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to stir a pot and smell delicious soup.

cleaner.about: A cleaner keeps streets, schools, and buildings neat and healthy. Cleaners sweep, wipe, and throw trash in the right place.
cleaner.funFact: Did you know? When we throw waste in bins, we help cleaners and keep our neighborhood beautiful.
cleaner.try: Say "{name}!" Pick up one scrap of paper and put it in a bin.

gardener.about: A gardener cares for plants, flowers, and trees in parks and gardens. Gardeners water plants, remove weeds, and help green spaces grow.
gardener.funFact: Did you know? Trees and plants give us fresh air and shade. Gardeners help those plants stay strong.
gardener.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to water a plant and gently touch a leaf.

pilot.about: A pilot flies airplanes safely in the sky. Pilots check weather, follow maps, and help passengers travel far.
pilot.funFact: Did you know? Pilots talk to the airport tower so every plane takes off and lands safely.
pilot.try: Say "{name}!" Hold your arms out like wings and pretend to fly slowly.

librarian.about: A librarian cares for books in a library. Librarians help children find stories and learn to borrow books politely.
librarian.funFact: Did you know? Libraries keep thousands of books so everyone can read and learn for free.
librarian.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to open a book and turn one page carefully.

tailor.about: A tailor stitches clothes so they fit well. Tailors use needles, thread, and measuring tapes to make shirts, dresses, and uniforms.
tailor.funFact: Did you know? A good tailor measures carefully so clothes feel comfortable when you move and play.
tailor.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to measure your arm with a finger tape and stitch in the air.

barber.about: A barber cuts and styles hair. Barbers use clean combs and scissors and help people look neat and fresh.
barber.funFact: Did you know? Sitting still in the barber chair helps the barber cut hair safely and evenly.
barber.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to comb your hair gently and say "Thank you!"

carpenter.about: A carpenter makes useful things from wood — chairs, tables, doors, and toys. Carpenters measure carefully and work safely with tools.
carpenter.funFact: Did you know? Smooth sanding makes wooden furniture safe for little hands to touch.
carpenter.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to hammer softly and build a tiny toy table.

builder.about: A builder helps make houses, schools, and roads. Builders wear hard hats and work in teams to keep buildings strong.
builder.funFact: Did you know? Strong foundations under a house help it stay safe for many years.
builder.try: Say "{name}!" Stack soft blocks carefully like building a wall.

milkman.about: A milkman brings fresh milk to homes early in the morning. Milk helps children grow strong bones and healthy bodies.
milkman.funFact: Did you know? Milk comes from cows and buffaloes on farms before it reaches your cup.
milkman.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to carry a milk bottle carefully and place it by the door.

electrician.about: An electrician fixes lights, fans, and wires safely. Electricians help homes and schools stay bright and working.
electrician.funFact: Did you know? Children should never touch switches with wet hands — electricity needs grown-up care.
electrician.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to switch on a light and clap when the room feels bright.

plumber.about: A plumber fixes taps, pipes, and drains so clean water can flow. Plumbers stop leaks and help bathrooms and kitchens work well again.
plumber.funFact: Did you know? A tiny leak can waste a lot of water. Plumbers find the leak and seal it carefully.
plumber.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to turn a tap and fix a drip with a toy wrench.

mechanic.about: A mechanic checks engines, wheels, and brakes so vehicles stay safe. Mechanics listen for strange sounds and repair parts with care.
mechanic.funFact: Did you know? Mechanics use special tools to check a car’s health, almost like a doctor checkup for vehicles.
mechanic.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to open a car hood and tighten an imaginary bolt.

taxiDriver.about: A taxi driver takes people safely from one place to another. Drivers know roads, watch traffic carefully, and help passengers reach on time.
taxiDriver.funFact: Did you know? Taxi drivers often use maps and road signs so every trip stays clear and safe.
taxiDriver.try: Say "{name}!" Hold an imaginary steering wheel and pretend to stop for a passenger.

securityGuard.about: A security guard watches gates, buildings, and busy places. Guards greet visitors politely and help keep people and property safe.
securityGuard.funFact: Did you know? Security guards stay alert and notice unusual things so they can ask for help quickly.
securityGuard.try: Stand tall, say "{name}!" and pretend to check a visitor badge at a gate.

cobbler.about: A cobbler mends shoes, sandals, and slippers. Cobblers stitch, glue, and fix soles so we can walk comfortably again.
cobbler.funFact: Did you know? Good shoe repair can make old shoes feel almost new and save them from being thrown away.
cobbler.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to stitch a shoe and tap the sole gently.

pharmacist.about: A pharmacist gives the right medicines from a pharmacy. Pharmacists read labels carefully and explain how to take medicine safely.
pharmacist.funFact: Did you know? Pharmacists check each medicine bottle so families get exactly what the doctor advised.
pharmacist.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to hand a medicine bottle carefully and say "Take it with water."

ambulanceDriver.about: An ambulance driver rushes sick or hurt people to the hospital quickly. Drivers use sirens carefully and clear the way for urgent help.
ambulanceDriver.funFact: Did you know? When an ambulance siren sounds, other vehicles move aside so help can reach faster.
ambulanceDriver.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to drive carefully and make a gentle siren sound.

lifeguard.about: A lifeguard watches people at pools and beaches. Lifeguards blow whistles, teach water safety, and rescue swimmers who need help.
lifeguard.funFact: Did you know? Lifeguards practice swimming and rescue skills often so they can act fast in water.
lifeguard.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to sit on a tall chair and blow an imaginary whistle.

deliveryPerson.about: A delivery person brings parcels, food, and packages to homes. They read addresses carefully and hand items to the right door.
deliveryPerson.funFact: Did you know? Clear house numbers help delivery people find your door faster every day.
deliveryPerson.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to carry a parcel bag and ring an imaginary doorbell.

garbageCollector.about: A garbage collector takes waste from bins so streets stay clean. Collectors help keep neighborhoods healthy and fresh.
garbageCollector.funFact: Did you know? When we sort waste into the right bins, garbage collectors can recycle more and keep towns cleaner.
garbageCollector.try: Say "{name}!" Pick up a scrap of paper and put it into a bin carefully.

dhobi.about: A dhobi washes and presses clothes with care. Dhobis scrub, rinse, and dry clothes so families wear clean outfits.
dhobi.funFact: Did you know? Soft soap and clean water help clothes stay bright without harsh scrubbing.
dhobi.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to wash a cloth in a bowl and hang it to dry.

fisherman.about: A fisherman catches fish from rivers, lakes, and the sea. Fishermen wake early, use nets or rods, and bring fresh fish to market.
fisherman.funFact: Did you know? Many fishing boats leave before sunrise so the catch stays fresh for families.
fisherman.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to cast a fishing line and gently pull in a fish.

soldier.about: A soldier protects the country and helps people in hard times. Soldiers train carefully, follow orders, and work as a brave team.
soldier.funFact: Did you know? Soldiers practice drills so they can stay calm, strong, and ready to help.
soldier.try: Stand straight, salute politely, and say "{name}!"

lawyer.about: A lawyer helps people understand fair rules and solve problems peacefully. Lawyers listen carefully and explain what is right and kind.
lawyer.funFact: Did you know? Fair rules help everyone feel safe, just like classroom rules help children play kindly together.
lawyer.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to open a book of rules and share one kind classroom rule.

goldsmith.about: A goldsmith shapes gold and silver into beautiful jewelry. Goldsmiths melt, hammer, and polish metal to make rings and bangles.
goldsmith.funFact: Did you know? Tiny tools help goldsmiths carve delicate patterns into shiny metal.
goldsmith.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to polish a shiny ring and show it with a smile.

blacksmith.about: A blacksmith heats iron and shapes it into strong tools. Blacksmiths use hammers and fire carefully to make useful metal things.
blacksmith.funFact: Did you know? Hot metal becomes soft enough to bend, then cools hard and strong again.
blacksmith.try: Say "{name}!" Pretend to swing a soft hammer and shape an imaginary horseshoe.
